observations.printed_mark: " (ditto) on lot 28's Kittyhawk edge, resolving to 55 printed on lot 27's Kittyhawk edge
observations.reason: Identity: map header reads 4103 / 9. Tract label 'TRACT NO 11569 M B 303-17' is split across the row. Lot 28 contains circled assessor number 16, matching AIN 4103-009-016. Width: the Kittyhawk frontage of lot 28 carries a ditto mark (about x=0.439, y=0.783). The chain runs southwest to the adjacent lot 27, whose Kittyhawk edge has an explicitly printed '55' (about x=0.418, y=0.819). Lot 27's rear edge is also printed '55' (about x=0.37, y=0.75), and lot 28's rear edge carries a ditto mark (about x=0.391, y=0.712). Equal opposite widths are consistent with a rectangular lot. The printed bearings and the 125 depth are on other lines, so no depth is derived.
observations.confidence_reason: Model reading corroborated against parcel geometry; not a survey or legal review.

frontage.reason: The north arrow on the left margin points straight up the page. Lot 28 is in the row of lots 26-39 between the common rear line, shared with lots 14-25, and KITTYHAWK AVE. The Kittyhawk Ave street line runs along the lower-right edge of lot 28. With north at the top, that lower-right edge faces southeast. The ditto mark on the street-side edge of lot 28 marks that edge as the frontage.

uncertainties: Lot 28 has no printed depth. The nearest depth mark, '125', is on the lot 26/27 side line, and another '125' appears at lot 39. Lot 28's own side lines carry no dimension.

The printed bearings are 'N 46°51'26"W' (along the lot 34/35 area) and what appears to be 'N 43°08'26"W' (along the Kittyhawk side). Both read 'W', and the angles sum to 89°59'52" rather than exactly 90°. They therefore do not cleanly establish perpendicularity. For that reason the derived-parallel depth and the derived-rectangle area are omitted.
Tract 11569 is confirmed from the split tract label and the 'M B 303' / '17' marks along the row. The label is fragmented across several lots, and the '17' could be part of a different reference.
The rectangular shape is a visual judgment based on equal opposite widths (55 / ditto). Lot 28 itself has no closure dimensions.
